item.description: • Press Backspace to delete the selected messages in the mail list
• Mailfan now counts how many people use it each day, with a random install ID and nothing from your mail

• Meeting invites show as a card with Add to Calendar
  • Run Mailfan actions from Shortcuts
  • Recipients are suggested from your Contacts as you type
  • Quoted text in replies tucks away behind Show Quotes
  • Links in mail open without tracking parameters
  • Sign-in emails get an Open Link button
  • See the sender's domain at a glance, open their website from the header, and copy their name or email
  • Mailfan tells you when your server marked a message as spam, and Not Junk moves it back
  • Moving mail to Junk now teaches your server's spam filter too
  • Conversations follow your server's own threads on IMAP and JMAP
  • Trusted MCP tokens can send email without asking each time
  • Account settings in clear sections, with account and tag colors picked from a popover

• Every account in one calm inbox: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP, POP3 or JMAP server
  • Triage from the keyboard with archive, snooze, pin, Reply Later, undo send and a command palette
  • Inbox split into People, Updates and Newsletters, plus rules, templates and send later
  • AI summaries, reply drafts and Ask your inbox with Apple Intelligence, Ollama, LM Studio or your own key
  • Claude, Cursor and other agents can search and draft mail through MCP, with tokens you scope
  • Your mail stays on your Mac
  • Try everything free for 14 days, then keep it with a one-time license
